comment: shk.c splitbill() 3633-3637 and onbill() 1150-1153. Sell three wished darts in a general store on level 2 and pick them up (unpaid); #wiztelekinesis hurtles the keeper out without setpaid(), so u_left_shop() finds him away and the hero levelports to 6 still owing for the darts. In level 6's armor shop, throwing one dart splits the stack: onbill() does not find it on that keeper's bill, and splitbill() reports it. The recording stops inside splitbill()'s report: the landing dart then reaches sub_one_frombill(), whose synchronous onbill() call the port leaves as a gap, so the last line of the report gets no --More-- in the port.
